fix: When a PASS ship's diff satisfies an item's acceptance surface, the SHIP phase consumes the item (move to consumed/ with the ship SHA) in the same commit — no scheduled consumption cards. Close-out verification belongs to the memo phase, not a new lane. Wiring proof: a fixture PASS landing an item's predicates must consume it transactionally; a partial landing must NOT.
notes: Measured: ~2h/night of lane time is bookkeeping. DOCS per operating-policy 3.8.
summary: Overnight ~3-4 of ~20 cycles were bookkeeping-shaped (consume-contract-block-cli-escalation-inbox-item, close-out cards, readme staleness) — each ran scout->triage->tdd->build->audit->ship (~25-30 min) to move/edit a JSON file. The 2026-07-20 forensics already named the class ('item-consumption must be transactional with landing', 949/948); the crosspoll PASS consumed its item in-ship while the egps PASS did not — the asymmetry is still live.
title: Bookkeeping cycles: consuming an inbox item costs a FULL pipeline cycle — consumption must ride the landing ship transactionally
